stewards.name: UCP Governing Council
stewards.role: Owns all UCP assets; 5 seats (Google and Shopify permanent, Stripe elected, 2 open as of 2026-10-20).

stewards.name: Google
stewards.role: Launched UCP, holds a permanent seat and the proxy vote for open seats until December 2028, custodian of ucp.dev.

stewards.name: Domain Tech Councils (Shopping, Food, Lodging, Payments)
stewards.role: 16-seat councils (some seats permanent), members elected every 6 months; the Payments council includes Adyen, Ant International, Coinbase, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe (roster as of 2026-10-20).

implementers.name: Google AI Mode in Search and Gemini
implementers.role: Platform; UCP checkout for US shoppers, starting with Etsy and Wayfair on 2026-02-11. Google said on 2026-09-16 that UCP enables direct checkout for hundreds of thousands of brands and retailers (a marketing figure). Google's own implementation guides cover UCP 2026-04-08 and 2026-01-23; no 2026-08-25 guide existed on 2026-10-20.

implementers.name: Etsy and Wayfair
implementers.role: Businesses live on Google surfaces from 2026-02-11.

implementers.name: Shopify, Target and Walmart
implementers.role: Businesses; Google said on 2026-02-11 that their UCP checkout was coming soon. Target's fact sheet (updated 2026-06-18) says shoppers buy directly from Target in Google Search, AI Mode and Gemini. Shopify's help center says direct checkout is on by default for eligible US stores. Walmart's live status rests only on Google's 2026-10-15 Universal Cart post, which names all three among its merchants without stating native checkout or cart transfer per merchant.

implementers.name: Shopify merchants (native checkout on Google)
implementers.role: Shopify's help center says direct checkout in Google AI Mode and Gemini is on by default for eligible stores (US-based, US customers, Merchant Center account), with an opt-out; still rolling out. The enrollment date of about 2026-09-22 is reported (ppc.land).

implementers.name: Google Universal Cart
implementers.role: Google shopping product that uses UCP for checkout; announced 2026-05-19, launched in the US on 2026-10-15 across Google Search and the Gemini app. A product, not the protocol.

implementers.name: Microsoft Copilot Checkout and Merchant Center
implementers.role: Copilot Checkout requires a UCP-compliant feed; Microsoft says MMC will support UCP (future tense).

implementers.name: Stripe
implementers.role: Documents a Stripe Payments handler for UCP.

implementers.name: Adyen
implementers.role: Documents a UCP Tokenization Handler bound to checkout session and merchant.

sdks.name: @ucp-js/sdk
sdks.note: Zod schemas and TypeScript types; published 2026-09-02.

sdks.name: ucp-schema
sdks.note: Runtime resolution of UCP schema annotations; 2026-08-03.

metrics.definition: Unique names across the Shopping, Lodging and Food co-developer lists.
metrics.caveat: Google appears in three verticals (23 logo slots); a count of names, not of integrations.

metrics.definition: Names in the endorser list on the homepage.
Google's statement about tech, payments and retail companies.

metrics.metric: Merchants with UCP direct checkout on Google (Google's figure)
metrics.definition: Google's statement of 2026-09-16 that UCP already enables direct checkout for hundreds of thousands of brands and retailers across Google.
metrics.caveat: A marketing figure with no definition or list; no exact merchant count is published by Google or the project (as of 2026-10-20).

metrics.definition: No transaction count or value from Google, Google's FAQ or ucp.dev.

costs.caveat: Platform and PSP fees are separate from the protocol.

costs.item: Google cut of agentic checkout sales
costs.value: Google told The Register it does not plan to take a cut
costs.caveat: A statement of intent to a reporter, not a published fee schedule; Google's UCP FAQ and Merchant Center help carried no fee text on 2026-10-20.

costs.value: The merchant's normal PSP fees; the PSP must be able to process Google's tokens
costs.caveat: Stated by Shopify for its merchants (standard payment processing fees only); for other merchants an inference from the merchant-of-record and PSP roles, since Google's FAQ does not mention fees.

costs.item: Shopify merchants on Google AI Mode and Gemini direct checkout
costs.value: No fees beyond standard payment processing fees (Shopify's statement about its channel)
costs.caveat: Shopify's help center, not a Google fee schedule. Shopify's Agentic Storefronts terms (updated 2026-10-06) let Shopify assess a fee for certain participating channels; the terms print no rate and name no channel.

costs.value: None today; Microsoft says it takes no commission or affiliate fee
costs.caveat: Microsoft's own page, worded 'today'; a policy statement, not a fee schedule. Secondary coverage of 2026-01-21 reported no additional fees for Google and Microsoft checkouts for now.

costs.item: Google Pay on Google AI surfaces
costs.caveat: Affects which credentials reach the PSP, not a fee.
